title: Three questions. Three meanings.
alt_text: OBLIGRA VERIFY RESOURCE HUB  /  09 REVIEW VOCABULARY Three questions. Three meanings. Validation, verification and correctness must stay separate. 01 Validation Did the submission meet the record contract? Verify · at submission 02 Verification Does the retained record still match capture? Verify · on-demand integrity check 03 Correctness Was this the right outcome for the situation? Customer review program · domain judgment A valid submission and an unchanged record do not establish a correct, complete or compliant decision. obligra.ai  /  Resource Hub Concept explainer · Read the linked source
editorial_note: Preserves submission validation, record integrity verification, and customer-owned correctness review.
